source_citation: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, First Schedule, Table I (see Rule 2(e), Rule 22)
note: Exactly one of max_error_percent or max_error_absolute applies per band, per the source table. Rounding: for declared quantity <=1000, round the computed error to the nearest one-tenth of a g/ml; for >1000, round to the next whole g/ml (Rule 22(2)/Schedule note).
